rationale: The long thesis remains intact — price holds above VWAP ($42.55) and the 9-EMA ($42.71), sits at 94% of the day's range just under the $42.77 high, and still shows relative strength against a weak SPY, with the post-entry drift being an orderly 2-cent consolidation on fading volume rather than a breakdown. Risk stays tightly defined at the $42.69 invalidation (~6 cents) versus the $42.86 gap-fill target (~11 cents), so there is no mechanical trigger to exit, and flipping short against above-VWAP strength has no supporting evidence. Confidence stays modest given prior-day supply at $42.84–$42.87 overhead and the lack of upward follow-through since entry.
